devdoc.details: ERC721 collection that supports off-chain minting proposals and image management.

AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

AgentAddressNotFound(string,string).details: Error when the typed address to remove is not registered to the agent.

params.addressType: The type of the address that was not found.
params.value: The canonical value of the address that was not found.

ERC721IncorrectOwner(address,uint256,add.details: Indicates an error related to the ownership over a particular token. Used in transfers.

params.owner: Address of the current owner of a token.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC721InsufficientApproval(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `operator`’s approval. Used in transfers.

params.operator: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC721InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC721InvalidOperator(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `operator` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.operator: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC721InvalidOwner(address).details: Indicates that an address can't be an owner. For example, `address(0)` is a forbidden owner in ERC-20. Used in balance queries.

params.owner: Address of the current owner of a token.

ERC721InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC721InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC721NonexistentToken(uint256).details: Indicates a `tokenId` whose `owner` is the zero address.

EmptyAddressValue(string).details: Error when an address value is empty.

params.addressType: The type of the address with the empty value.

InvalidAddressType(string,string).details: Error when an address type is empty or not lowercase alphanumeric.

params.addressType: The address type that is not valid.
params.value: The value of the offending entry, to identify it in a list.

InvalidCloneOf(uint256).details: Error when the cloneOf is invalid.

params.cloneOf: The cloneOf that is not valid.

InvalidCollectionName(string).details: Error when the collection name is not a valid ENS label.

params.name: The collection name that is not valid.

InvalidEvmAddressValue(string).details: Error when an evm address value is not a parseable non-zero hex address.

params.value: The value that is not valid.

InvalidName(string).details: Error when the name is invalid.

params.name: The name that is not valid.

MissingDefaultImage().details: Error when no image with key `default` is present.

MissingEvmAddress().details: Error when a mint carries no evm-typed address.

NoModerators().details: Error when no moderators are set but the action requires moderators.

NotModerator(address).details: Error when the caller is not a moderator but moderators are set.

params.sender: The address that attempted the action.

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address,uint2.details: Error when the sender is not the owner of the token.

params.sender: The address that attempted the action.
params.tokenId: The ID of the token that was attempted to be accessed.

ProposalNotFound(uint256).details: Error when no pending proposal exists for the given id.

params.proposalId: The proposal id that was not found.

StringsInsufficientHexLength(uint256,uin.details: The `value` string doesn't fit in the specified `length`.

UsedAgentAddress(string,string,uint256).details: Error when the typed address is already in use (tokenId 0 = duplicate within the submitted list).

params.addressType: The type of the address that is already in use.
params.tokenId: The token ID associated with the address.
params.value: The canonical value of the address that is already in use.

UsedName(string,uint256).details: Error when the name is already in use.

params.name: The name that is already in use.
params.tokenId: The token ID associated with the name.

ZeroAddress(string).details: Error when a required address argument is the zero address.

params.parameter: The name of the parameter that was the zero address.

AgentAddressAdded(uint256,string,string).details: Emitted when a typed address is added to an agent.

params.addressType: The type of the address added.
params.tokenId: The ID of the agent token.
params.value: The canonical value of the address added.

AgentAddressRemoved(uint256,string,strin.details: Emitted when a typed address is removed from an agent.

params.addressType: The type of the address removed.
params.tokenId: The ID of the agent token.
params.value: The canonical value of the address removed.

AgentAttributeUpdated(uint256,string,str.details: Emitted when an agent's metadata key is updated.

params.key: The key of the metadata that was updated.
params.newValue: The new value of the metadata.
params.oldValue: The previous value of the metadata.
params.tokenId: The ID of the token whose metadata was updated.

AgentImageProposalCreated(uint256,string.details: Emitted when an image proposal is created.

params.key: The key of the image proposal.
params.proposalId: The id of the created proposal.
params.tokenId: The ID of the token whose image is proposed.

AgentImageProposalRemoved(uint256,string.details: Emitted when an image proposal is removed.

params.key: The key of the image proposal.
params.proposalId: The id of the removed proposal.
params.tokenId: The ID of the token whose proposal was removed.

AgentImageUpdated(uint256,string,string,.details: Emitted when an agent image is added or updated.

params.newValue: The new value of the image.
params.oldValue: The previous value of the image.
params.tokenId: The ID of the token whose image was added or updated.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `owner` enables `approved` to manage the `tokenId` token.

ApprovalForAll(address,address,bool).details: Emitted when `owner` enables or disables (`approved`) `operator` to manage all of its assets.

CollectionsDescriptorUpdated(address,add.details: Emitted when the collections descriptor is updated.

DescriptionUpdated(string,string).details: Emitted when the collection description is updated.

params.newDescription: The new description of the collection.
params.oldDescription: The previous description of the collection.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

MintProposalCreated(address,uint256).details: Emitted when a mint proposal is created.

params.from: The address that initiated the proposal.
params.proposalId: The id of the created proposal.

MintProposalRemoved(address,uint256).details: Emitted when a mint proposal is removed.

params.owner: The address that was set to receive the token.
params.proposalId: The id of the removed proposal.

Minted(address,uint256).details: Emitted when a token is minted.

params.to: The address that receives the minted token.
params.tokenId: The ID of the minted token.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted to signal this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `tokenId` token is transferred from `from` to `to`.

addAgentAddress(uint256,string,string).details: Add a typed address to an agent (agent controller only).

addOrUpdateAgentAttribute(uint256,string.details: Add the attribute key/value pair to a token. If the key already exists, its value is updated.

params.tokenId: The token whose attribute key is updated.
params.value: The new value for the attribute key.

addOrUpdateAgentImage(uint256,(string,st.details: Add or update an image for a token. (allowed when no moderators are setup or the caller is a moderator)

params.image: The key/value pair representing the image.

params.proposalId: The id of the proposal to apply.

addOrUpdateAgentImageProposal(uint256).details: Get an image proposal by index.

addressOfByIndex(uint256,uint256).details: Get a specific typed address of an agent by its index.

addressToTokenId(string,string).details: Get the token ID associated to a typed address, or 0 if none.

params.value: The address value (evm values accepted in any casing).

addressesCountOf(uint256).details: Get the number of typed addresses of an agent.

attributeOfByIndex(uint256,uint256).details: Get a specific attribute of an agent by its index.

attributesCountOf(uint256).details: Get the number of attributes of an agent.

createAddOrUpdateAgentImageProposal(uint.details: Propose to add or update an image for a token. (used if moderators setup)

params.image: The key/value pair representing the image.
params.tokenId: The token affected by the proposal.

createMintProposal(address,string,string.details: Propose minting of a new agent token. (used if moderators setup)

params.addresses: Typed addresses controlled by the agent (at least one evm).
params.attributes: A set of attributes describing the agent.
params.cloneOf: The ID of the agent to clone (if any).
params.images: A set of images describing the agent.
params.name: The Name of the agent.
params.to: The future owner of the token.

creatorOf(uint256).details: Get the creator address of an agent.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

imageOfByIndex(uint256,uint256).details: Get a specific image of an agent by its index.

imagesCountOf(uint256).details: Get the number of images of an agent.

informationOf(uint256).details: Get all stored information for an agent.

params.admin: Address granted the default admin role.
params.name: ERC721 name of the collection.

isModerator(address).details: Get the fact that a account is a moderator or not.

mint(address,string,string,(string,strin.details: Mint a new agent token. (allowed when no moderators are setup or the caller is a moderator)

params.addresses: Typed addresses controlled by the agent (at least one evm).
params.attributes: A set of attributes describing the agent.
params.cloneOf: The ID of the agent to clone (if any).
params.images: A set of images describing the agent.
params.name: The Name of the agent.
params.to: The future owner of the token.

mintFromProposal(uint256).details: Mint an agent from an approved proposal.

params.proposalId: The id of the mint proposal to execute.

mintProposal(uint256).details: Get a mint proposal by index.

nameOf(uint256).details: Get the name of an agent

nameToTokenId(string).details: Get the token ID associated to the agent name.

params.proposalId: The id of the proposal to refuse.
The id of the proposal to refuse.

removeAgentAddress(uint256,string,string.details: Remove a typed address from an agent (agent controller only).

removeAgentImage(uint256,string).details: Remove an image from a token.

params.key: The key of the image to remove.
params.tokenId: The token whose image is removed.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

roleOf(uint256).details: Get the role of an agent

tokenURI(uint256).details: Return the token URI as defined by the descriptor contract.

updateCollectionsDescriptor(address).details: Update the descriptor contract used for metadata.

params.newCollectionsDescriptor: Address of the new descriptor contract.

params.newDescription: The new description of the collection.

collectionsDescriptor.details: Address of the collections descriptor contract.

moderatorCount.details: Number of moderators configured on the collection.

nextTokenId.details: The next tokenId to be minted (count of minted agents + 1).
